data.title: 木更 · 屋顶晾衣
data.description: 晴朗公寓天台上，木更换上浅桃短袖棉质Polo、米白宽松工装长裤与浅色帆布便鞋，踮起脚尖，左手把白床单上缘托到晾衣绳，右手夹上一枚衣夹。近处洗衣篮里还有折好的衬衫，小衣夹盒放在篮边；已经挂好的床单沿晾绳通向远侧扶栏，栏外能看见邻楼天台与蓝色海平线。右后日光穿过薄床单，照亮布边和粉发，床单影子落在地砖与裤脚旁——「阳光超级好呢！修的衣服全都被晒得香喷喷的，就像一直被修抱在怀里一样幸福。」
data.location: 海边公寓天台晾衣区，扶栏外可见邻楼屋顶与海平线
data.action: 踮脚用左手托床单上缘靠近晾绳，右手夹上一枚衣夹，笑着回头。
data.lighting: back-right daylight transmitted through sheets; moving fabric shadows on rooftop tiles
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, raised hands, peg contact and laundry line visible
data.promptProse: Fresh white sheets run along the clothesline above Kisara's apartment rooftop. On tiptoe, she lifts the next sheet's upper edge with her left hand and fastens a peg with her right, turning back with an easy smile. An opaque peach polo and off-white utility trousers suit the chore beneath long pink hair. A basket of folded shirts and a small peg box sit near the lower frame edge. Already hung sheets lead toward the far railing; neighboring roofs and a blue sea horizon remain visible past it. Use an eye-level medium view that shows the peg meeting both line and fabric. Daylight from the back right transmits through the lifted sheet and catches her hair edge. Billowing cloth casts moving shadows across the roof tiles near her shoes, while folds facing away from the sun remain softly shaded.
